subject: Intro: Redwood Inference demo / timeline update
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@greenharbor.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Redwood Inference demo — availability

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the time last week — it was great hearing about the plans at Green Harbor Logistics. I wanted to lock in a short 30-minute demo so we can show the latency/cost tradeoffs that matter to your routing team. Below are a few windows that work on our side this week: 

- Wed 2026-04-14 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu 2026-04-15 13:00–13:30 PT
- Fri 2026-04-16 09:00–09:30 PT

If none of those work, send a couple times that are better and I’ll move things around. I attached a one-pager and a proposed SOW template for context.

Also cc'ing Marissa (solutions) so she can join the demo and cover integration questions.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0217
redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf, proposed-sow-template.docx
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@greenharbor.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenharbor.com
Date: 2026-04-09T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood Inference demo — availability

Rafael —

Thanks for the options and for the materials. Quick update from our side: the executive team reprioritized a number of projects this quarter and the LLM/inference work has been pushed behind a couple of higher-priority initiatives (warehouse control system and fleet routing MVP). On top of that, a few of the folks who would evaluate your demo (including our Head of ML) are traveling for the next two weeks.

Given that, we need to pause active demos for Q2. I don’t want to string you along — can we postpone the demo and (for now) keep this on our radar with a touchpoint in early July? If you have a 1-page ROI summary that highlights expected token cost reductions and latency improvements for at-scale deployments, please send it over. Also copy procurement — they’ve started a pause on new vendor evaluations until headcount approvals land.

Appreciate the transparency.
Jordan
Director, Product Data & ML | Green Harbor Logistics
jordan.lee@greenharbor.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@greenharbor.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-09T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood Inference demo — availability

Jordan — thanks for the heads up and totally understand. Short response with two options so we don’t lose momentum: 

1) I’ll send a focused 1-page ROI summary and a brief note comparing hosted vs. dedicated (will highlight token-level cost examples and likely latency ranges). If that’s helpful, procurement can triage the doc internally.

2) If you’re open to it, we can keep a 15-minute placeholder in July (I’ll make it optional so it doesn’t clog calendars). No demo necessary then — just a brief sync to re-evaluate timing.

Either way works — I’ll queue the materials to you and procurement. If it helps, I can surface a compact checklist for what a pilot would look like (estimated cost, timeline, minimal infra needs).

Would you prefer the materials via email or a shared Drive link?

Best,
Rafael

Attachments referenced: redwood-one-pager.pdf, proposed-sow-template.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Green Harbor follow-up (GH-749)

Rafael/Tessa — quick internal note after Jordan's reply:

- Status: Prospect deprioritized for Q2; procurement freeze mentioned.
- Action: Mark deal GH-749 as "paused" in HubSpot and set next task for 2026-07-05 to reach back out.
- Materials to prepare: 1-page ROI, pilot checklist, and an abbreviated SOW. Rafael will own materials.

HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/GH-749

Let's avoid sending multiple ask emails to procurement while they're in a freeze. We'll wait for Rafael's 1-pager and then include it in the July touchpoint.

Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@greenharbor.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenharbor.com
Date: 2026-04-18T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood Inference demo — availability

Rafael — following up to confirm: go ahead and cancel the tentative demo for April. Please send the 1-page ROI to procurement and me. We’ll revisit in early July; I’ll reply to your July outreach if the project re-enters the roadmap. For now, procurement has asked us not to start any vendor pilots.

Thanks for being flexible — Jordan
